lines.en: What separates a successful startup from a failing one is rarely the idea itself, but the way it is carried out.
Had the founders listened to their early customers, the company might have survived its first year.

Not only must an entrepreneur take risks, but they must also know which risks are worth taking.

What investors really look for is not a perfect plan, but a team they can trust.
